mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, username, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, phone, email, exp, level, status, role, followers_count AS followersCount, following_count AS followingCount, birthday, bio, gender FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userid}

select user.user_id, user.username, user.nickname, user.avatar_url, user.phone, user.email, user.exp, user.level, user.status, user.role, user.followers_count, user.following_count, user.birthday, user.bio, user.gender from user where user_id = #{uid};
